lines.label: What it holds

source.publisher: INFARMED - Autoridade Nacional do Medicamento e Produtos de Saúde, I.P.

lines.value: National database of human medicines for all citizens, covering medicines, active substances and presentations, with a filter for authorised and marketed products.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: INFARMED - Autoridade Nacional do Medicamento e Produtos de Saúde, I.P.

lines.value: INFARMED grants national marketing authorisations through the national, mutual recognition and decentralised procedures; centralised authorisations are decided by the European Commission, after which INFARMED assigns national registration numbers.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: INFARMED - Autoridade Nacional do Medicamento e Produtos de Saúde, I.P.

lines.value: Número de registo (AIM registration number) inside the EU unique identifier

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: INFARMED - Autoridade Nacional do Medicamento e Produtos de Saúde, I.P.

lines.value: The unique identifier is held in a 2D DataMatrix code with product code, serial number, batch, expiry date and the INFARMED-assigned registration number, which must be included; it applies from 9 February 2019.
